{{Quote|These turrets are the future of Imperial anti-personnel weaponry. And Lord Grathan wanted to keep them all to himself!|Bryn|<ref name="SW" />}}
An anti-personnel '''prototype turret''' model was developed by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan|Grathan's]] [[Lord Grathan's forces|forces]] during or prior to [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Year" />

==Description==
The turrets were large unmanned anti-personnel emplacements capable of [[Flamethrower/Legends|projecting flames]]. The efficacy of the turrets was tested on living, [[sentient]] subjects within the lab where they were developed.<ref name="SW" />

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bryn (Human)|Bryn]] requested the aid of a passing [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to retrieve the plans from [[Lord Grathan's estate]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="SW" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
[[File:Grathan_weapons_lab.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The turrets were stored in a lab within the main compound of Grathan's estate.]]
The Imperial spacer successfully infiltrated [[Lord Grathan's estate|Grathan's compound]], retrieving a security badge from one of the Grathan estate's guardsmen in order to pass by its automated defences. The spacer stole into [[Grathan weapons lab|Grathan's weapons lab]] and encountered [[PO-12]], a droid tasked with maintaining the turrets and protecting their schematics. The spacer downloaded the plans from PO-12's [[Databank/Legends|databanks]], much to the droid's chagrin, who wanted to destroy the schematics and ensure no more could be built. Upon the spacer's return, Bryn displayed an eagerness to test the efficacy of the turrets on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] personnel.<ref name="SW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The prototype turrets appear in the "Strange Weapons" exploration mission on Dromund Kaas, in the [[BioWare]]/[[LucasArts]] online [[roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="SW" /> released in [[2011]].<ref name="release">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20111014-1|text=Global Launch for The Old Republic}}</ref>

Players have two options during the quest: they can download the turret plans for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark alignment points]] or remove PO-12's [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] to allow the droid to delete the plans for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light alignment points]].<ref name="SW" />
